exposure: Contraception use (gestagen, intrauterine device (IUD), combined oral contraceptive (COC))
finding: Amenorrhea, breastfeeding, and progesterone-containing contraception were associated with a decreased risk of uterine niche development within one year after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study focuses on hysterotomy healing after cesarean section and does not directly compare outcomes related to other modes of delivery.
